cardiffcastle_guide.text: Welcome to Cardiff Castle: a Roman wall, a Norman keep and a Victorian fantasy. Pick an era.
The Romans built a fort here about AD 55. The Normans added a great mound and keep inside the old walls.
In the 1800s the third Marquess of Bute, one of the richest men in the world, hired William Burges to turn the castle into a Gothic fairy tale.

cardiffcastle_steward.text: Have you seen the Animal Wall outside? Stone lions, a bear, baboons and a hyena. Burges liked variety.
